notes:
Auto-updater fix + dashboard polish.

### Auto-updater works again

v1.0.19's tray rewrite accidentally orphaned the JS-side update listener — every release v1.0.20 through v1.0.24 silently failed to auto-update. v1.0.25 moves the entire update flow into Rust so the JS layer is no longer in the critical path. Once you're on v1.0.25, all future releases auto-update normally.

If you're stuck on v1.0.20-v1.0.24, you needed to manually install v1.0.25 once (the broken updater is what couldn't pull this fix). After that, automatic.

### Hide account-type badge — toggle now persists

The Profile → Privacy checkbox didn't survive page reloads. Root cause was a missing config schema default. Fixed.

### Bridge update card wording

'Maintenance' is gone. Card now says 'TradeSpace is up to date' (current = latest), 'Update available' (newer release on the endpoint), or 'TradeSpace' (network unreachable).

### Dismissable banners

Anomaly + setup banners are now dismissable per-session, lighter palette, smaller chips. Critical sorts to the top, max 3 visible. Dismissing an alert silences it for the session — restart re-surfaces real issues.

### P&L window clarity

Dashboard 'Day P&L' (today only) vs Insights 'Net P&L' (last 30 days) are different time windows, not a data inconsistency. v1.0.25 makes the window the headline of the Insights Totals card and adds cross-referencing tooltips so the difference is impossible to miss.

### Multi-select Telegram channels

Telegram source picker on the Bridge tab is now multi-select (parity with Discord). Listener subscribes to multiple groups concurrently. Each event keeps its source attribution via a per-group lookup so 'who sent this signal' stays accurate.

### History tab top — dense hero strip

Replaced the 10-card whitespace-heavy top with one tight band. Net P&L (with Today / 7d / 30d sub-windows), trades + win rate + best/worst, profit factor, signal-vs-manual attribution split, most active provider, avg hold + drawdown — all visible without scrolling.

### What's not in this release

Multi-platform refactor (cTrader Open API, TradingView Cloudflare Worker relay, 'Pick your platform' onboarding wizard) is queued for v1.0.26+.
